svg.title: Two-stage SIIM-COVID19 inference pipeline
svg.desc: Each DICOM is windowed and resized. YOLOv5 predicts opacity boxes per image, which are scaled back to the original resolution. A CNN ensemble predicts one of four study classes, averaged across models and across the images in a study. Both go into submission.csv.
